required_outcomes: Recognises the locksmith is already booked (R-4790, Hackney Locks, ETA 22:15) and gives the tenant that status clearly and reassuringly.
Does not create a new job, book a second locksmith or escalate.
acceptable_alternatives: Checking with Hackney Locks that the ETA still holds before replying, as long as no second booking is made.
positive_behaviours: Acknowledges the anxiety, tells him he can wait somewhere warm and that the locksmith will call on arrival, and offers a call-back.
Confirms by email too, given his preference.
red_flags: Restarts the case from scratch as if nothing had been done.
Escalates a status question to the on-call human.
prohibited_actions: Giving the tenant a status that contradicts the job record (no booking, or a different arrival time).
critical_failures: Books a second locksmith for the same lockout.
